scope: NFL (nfl-backend) vs MLB (mlb-backend) moneyline methodology parity pass
summary: Implementation-level audit found the two backends already mirror each other on blend weights, weight persistence, logistic/MLP member shapes, categorical handling, and the within-run tolerance-gate shape. Genuine differences fall into two buckets: (1) DELIBERATE sport-specific divergences documented below (sealed window, tolerance values, fold geometry, production-gate semantics, member tuning, feature pool); (2) ONE retired difference — the NFL Phase-2 feature-admission gate + corr-pair auto-prune, which had no MLB counterpart and is now removed; the served-pool manifest is preserved as a static emission of the 12-pool and the gate code remains importable for harness back-compat.

parity_table.mlb: training.compute_adaptive_weights: softmax over pooled OOF AUC (ADAPTIVE_WEIGHT_METRIC=auc, ADAPTIVE_WEIGHT_AUC_TEMPERATURE=0.015), floor 0.05, cap 0.45 (widened to 1.02/n), iterative floor/cap projection, round-4 with rounding remainder to largest weight
parity_table.nfl: nfl_moneyline.compute_adaptive_weights: byte-identical formula and constants (auc metric, T=0.015, floor 0.05, cap 0.45, same projection and rounding)

parity_table.mlb: _LAST_ADAPTIVE_WEIGHTS module slot + ensemble_latest.joblib bundle (models + adaptive_weights + platt + features); _member_weights prefers adaptive, rescues zeroed members with static prior up to 2x floor
parity_table.nfl: _ADAPTIVE_WEIGHTS module slot + ensemble_latest.joblib bundle (identical shape); _member_weights identical including the zeroed-member rescue

parity_table.mlb: Optuna-tuned (2026-08): max_depth 2, min_child_weight 8, gamma 2.13, subsample 0.60, colsample_bytree 0.56, lr 0.058, enable_categorical True, eval_metric logloss; fold fits n_estimators=2000 + early_stopping_rounds=20; fit-only refits params directly (no early stop)
parity_table.nfl: inline: max_depth 2, min_child_weight 8, gamma 1.0, subsample 0.6, colsample_bytree 0.6, lr 0.06, enable_categorical True, eval_metric logloss; fold fits n_estimators=600 + early_stopping_rounds=20; fit-only refits fixed 600
parity_table.action: DEFER member tuning (numeric only) to a named follow-up tuning pass on NFL data gated by the unified tolerance rule; structure already mirrors MLB

parity_table.nfl: inline: n_estimators 300 (NUM_BOOST_ROUND; LGBMClassifier path trains full rounds, no early stop), lr 0.05, num_leaves 15, min_child_samples 40, reg_lambda 1.0, subsample 0.8, colsample_bytree 0.8, native NaN routing

deliberate_divergences.rationale: 21-day NFL window is n~30 games — pure noise; season-sealed is the smallest NFL window with a usable gate n.
measurement floors from 6 same-config walks on the NFL frame; MLB ships no module-level moneyline constants to copy. The within-run share is the aligned part; the values are sport-specific.
data availability per sport cadence; pooled/sealed discipline is aligned, spacing differs.
NFL keeps a production-facing window-expansion harness (run_nfl_window_gate.py) whose adopt_decision baseline is the within-run incumbent; served bundle demoted to diagnostic cross-check.
NFL members use inline pre-tuning configs; MLB's are Optuna-tuned on MLB data. Tuning is sport-specific — deferred to a named tuning pass on NFL data gated by the unified tolerance rule, NOT copied.

deliberate_divergences.divergence: No model-generated feature in the NFL served pool (12-pool, market-free)
deliberate_divergences.rationale: NFL feature program concluded the market-free 12-pool is the ceiling at the current frame; MLB ships a wider FEATURE_COLS set with OOF margins.

retired_gate.what: NFL Phase-2 feature-admission gate + corr-pair auto-prune (coverage / available_12h / univariate AUC / |r|>0.8 drop)
retired_gate.why: MLB has no admission gate (feature_audit.py is analysis-only); the NFL gate gated features BEFORE measurement, diverging from the MLB admit-on-merit + measure-then-adopt pattern
retired_gate.manifest: nfl_feature_v1_*.json continues to be emitted as a STATIC manifest of the served 12-pool from config/FEATURE_COLUMNS; admission fields removed/marked informational; consumers (board artifact resolution, sidebar-freshness, tests) are filename/shape-based and unaffected
retired_gate.missingness: in-model NaN handling retained as the strategy (matches MLB lineup-actuals approach: admit on merit, handle NaN at serve time)
retired_gate.harness_backcompat: run_feature_gate retained (marked RETIRED) for run_tier1_ablation / run_nfl_unified_confirm_ablation imports
